release_notes: Added local user profiles with separate profile-specific data folders.
Users can now create, select, rename and delete Morsewurst profiles.
Each profile can have its own database, UI settings, network settings and debug data.
Existing legacy data is migrated into the default profile on first startup.
Deleted profiles are moved to a timestamped backup folder instead of being permanently removed.
Added regression tests for profile creation, activation, renaming, deletion, backup handling and legacy data migration.
Various bug fixes and UI responsiveness improvements.
